evidence: Source (pdftotext -layout): '  Boys 55 Meter Hurdles' / '     Top 8 Advance by Time' / '=====...' / ' 13 Smith, Thomas  12 Apponequet R  7.70   4'. The header is not accepted (ruler two lines below with 'Top 8 Advance by Time' between, parser.py:733-746), so the 33 hurdle prelim rows were appended to the Boys 2 Mile Run: parse has {'athlete':'Smith, Thomas','result':'7.70'} under 2 Mile Run, and the sync's repair_mark (scraper_v2.py:1741) made it '7:70'. Same for 'Girls 55 Meter Hurdles' (32 prelims, e.g. 'Scott, Anika 8.02q' -> Girls 2 Mile '8:02') and for 'Boys 55 Meter Dash' prelims (34 rows, e.g. 'Flahn, Ceasar 6.41') which were read into Girls Shot Put; the Girls 55 Dash prelims at the top of the file were lost. Second cause in the same file: '  ....Boys 2 Mile Run' (page continuation with no event number) is not recognised, so the continuation page's wider rows ('23 Fontaine, Elliott   12 Burlington-VT   9:51.15  1') were read under page 1's columns as result '12-', school 'Unknown' (Portland-ME's Charles Jacques mile 4:39.37 -> '12-'). Shot Put 9-11.00 is not metres: the source header is '  Boys Shot Put Wheelchair' (meet record 10-00.25), and normalize_event_name maps it to 'Shot Put'. The shared column-split patch (kvac2022_1.patch) changes nothing here: no page of this PDF is split into columns.

evidence: Source: 'Event 17  Girls Shot Put Relay' / '    Name   Year School   Finals  Points' / '  5 Belfast, Girls One           Belfast               71-06.50'. Every field event of the meet is a team total entered as an 'athlete' named '<School>, Girls One' / '<School>, Boys One'. parse_event_block's field-relay branch (parser.py:1241-1258) sees a Name/Year/School header, finds no 'Old Town A' style team rows (regex :1247), reads the rows as individuals and sets is_relay False; the sync flips the name to 'Girls One Belfast', which is_team_label does not know.
parser: backend/parser.py:Sub5ColumnParser.parse_event_block:1232-1258 (field-relay branch: team rows recognised only as 'Old Town A' via the regex at :1247; otherwise the Name/Year/School header makes it read rows as individuals and set is_relay False) and parse:779-792 (is_relay only from 'relay/4x/medley/shuttle' in the label, so 'TEAM' / '- TM' / plain 'Girls High Jump' field-team events are never relays)
fix: ne_relays_2.patch (backend/parser.py: Sub5ColumnParser.field_team_entries - a field event whose rows are team totals is returned as relay rows (school, mark, legs), so the sync stores '<school> Relay' / the legs and athlete_catalog never makes an athlete of it; winners' rows with legs printed inline are re-read from the raw line; 'Event N  COED ...' header recognised). Rule: label pattern '<team>, (Girls|Boys) One' plus the event label ending in 'Relay'. Tested: all 14 field events -> relay rows (139 rows), individual events untouched.
